title: Changing both name and rule logs both parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Choose a new name for term A that no term has; call the new name term B.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with the name of term B.
  4. Click the Day box.
  5. Type 10 in the Day box.
  6. Click "Save Changes".
  7. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  8. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 4:

  • The "Due day of the following month" option is selected.

Step 5:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 6:

  • A green success toast shows.

Step 7:

  • The menu opens.

Step 8:

  • The newest row reads "Credit term edited" with Details "Name: term A → term B" and "Due: 14 days after the invoice date → 10th of the following month".
